exposure: drinking of strong tea or coffee
cohort: 1,206 pregnant women admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology of Qinghai Red Cross Hospital from January 2016 to October 2021
finding: Pregnant women from the plateau region, especially those who are older or have a history of multiple pregnancies, childbirths, or abortions, have a high incidence of iron deficiency and iron-deficiency anemia.
